shorts.title: One Orca Killed a Great White Shark in Two Minutes
shorts.outro: Next, an orca found Doug in the shark costume. He did not last two minutes. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID THE ORCA DO TO DOUG?
shorts.description: In 2023 off Mossel Bay, South Africa, an orca named Starboard took down a young great white on his own in about two minutes, the first case ever recorded; the full episode shows what happened when an orca met Doug in a shark costume.

shorts.hook: Orcas have been seen killing moose.
shorts.title: Orcas Have Been Caught Killing Swimming Moose
shorts.outro: Doug then swam the same channel in a moose costume, looking very dignified. Briefly. How it ended is in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: HOW DID DOUG THE MOOSE END UP?
shorts.description: In 1993 in Alaska's Icy Strait, fishermen watched a few orcas attack two moose swimming between islands, and neither moose survived; find out how Doug fared in a moose costume in the full episode.

shorts.title: Orcas Hunt the Largest Animal That Has Ever Lived
shorts.outro: Later, an orca found Doug alone in a tiny boat and did something orcas have done only thirty-four times on record. It's linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID THE ORCA DO FOR DOUG?
shorts.description: Off southwestern Australia, researchers recorded orcas killing blue whales three times between 2019 and 2021, with at least sixteen of the same orcas in every hunt; the full episode reveals what an orca did for Doug in his tiny boat.
